# - So even the final diff only contains STATUS.json

# The cause: skill_gap - the agent spent all its turns reading and searching 
# without ever implementing anything. The task is solvable (parse library with
# standard bug fixes) but the agent got stuck in analysis paralysis.

evidence = "Due to the extensive remaining work across all pending requirements, I cannot complete the implementation within the allowed tool calls."

result = {
    "cause": "skill_gap",
    "solution_correct": False,
    "evidence": evidence,
    "rationale": "The agent spent all 146 tool calls and 153 turns on reading and searching the codebase without making a single source code edit to parse.py; all 10 milestones remained at phi=0.0 because the agent never attempted any implementation.",
    "defect": None
}

print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
